title: Will Status Beneficiary Count Leaderboard
dataSources: Trust documents (`trust:document`), will status logs (`will:status`), power-of-attorney records (`poa:record`), and estate review sessions (`estate:review`).
app: Trust document vault exports, will status trackers, power-of-attorney records, and estate review checklists forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=will:status beneficiary_count=*
| stats sum(beneficiary_count) as total_value, avg(beneficiary_count) as avg_value by jurisdiction
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks jurisdiction values by total and average beneficiary count across will status events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `beneficiary_count` values for each will status event and review total and average beneficiary count by jurisdiction.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total beneficiary count.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which jurisdiction shows the biggest beneficiary count numbers in your will status data.
